items.title: Tech outages are causing people to panic-buy. Costco is benefiting, Mizuho says
items.why: Outage-driven stockpiling shows how sudden disruptions shift spend toward warehouse clubs and away from other channels.
items.summary_ai: Mizuho says tech outages are driving panic buying that benefits Costco.
items.take: Outage-driven stockpiling shows how sudden disruptions shift spend toward warehouse clubs and away from other channels.
